title: Pin current above the board's limit

implements.text: A pin reports over-current while its current exceeds the board's pin limit (40 mA on the Uno and ESP32 profiles, 8 to 12 mA on the Pico, Nano 33 and micro:bit profiles); it clears when the current falls

mocked.text: Once the rule fires the part stays burnt until it is repaired; the real part may survive or fail more slowly

unsupported.text: Thermal history; only the threshold and its dwell are checked

parameterSources.note: the profile values are not cited to a datasheet

validation.dataset: figures/engine/bench-solve.test.mjs: a HIGH input sinks its output, and the coil on it carries about 80 mA

operatingRange.evidence: largest pinMaxMa among the board profiles

knownFailureCases: The pin limit is a warning level, not the absolute maximum rating
